repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(all(#SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound <= 30)
triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30)
all(#AirPurifier).airPurifier_setAirPurifierMode("sleep")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` to sample the rising edge condition, which fails to detect the transition if it occurs between script iterations. The IR requires a blocking wait for the rising edge (`wait(cond, edge rising)`) to ensure the action fires exactly at the moment the condition becomes true, regardless of the wrapper period.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the required blocking two-wait rearming pattern: check if already fired, block until condition is false, block until condition is true, execute body, then mark fired. This preserves the rising-edge semantics and the 1 SEC cycle period.
